re-asd-id-server.title: re-asd-id-server
re-asd-id-server.observation: UDS Keycloak explicitly enables Quarkus access logging, requests client certificates and configures forwarded Istio client certificate lookup; provider is a separate product component supplying app identity controls.

re-asd-trust.title: re-asd-trust
re-asd-trust.observation: Imports hash-pinned official DoD approved-external PKI trust chains, filters unwanted certificate classes and excludes expired certificates; Dockerfile/sync install truststores.

re-asd-logging.title: re-asd-logging
re-asd-logging.observation: API request logs have method/outcome/time/service/trace/remoteAddress and recursive field/text secret redaction; common binding has no actor and does not include User-Agent/Referer.

re-asd-logging-tests.title: re-asd-logging-tests
re-asd-logging-tests.observation: Tests cover nested headers/payload/error/message credential redaction, HTTP cycles, authorization schemes and correlation IDs.

re-asd-roles.title: re-asd-roles
re-asd-roles.observation: App authorization role changes have append-only actor/subject/tenant/action audit records; this does not cover all denied/object access operations.

re-asd-guard.title: re-asd-guard
re-asd-guard.observation: API authenticates from explicit Authorization Bearer header rather than ambient browser cookies; validated user context precedes domain permissions.

re-asd-jwt.title: re-asd-jwt
re-asd-jwt.observation: jose verifies JWT issuer/audience/signature/expiry offline; no token introspection/session or account revocation lookup for already-issued tokens.

re-asd-auth.title: re-asd-auth
re-asd-auth.observation: Browser uses OIDC authorization code/PKCE and persistent localStorage userStore with automatic silent renew.

re-asd-logout.title: re-asd-logout
re-asd-logout.observation: Explicit logout removes user/stale OIDC state, clears persisted app data and queries and invokes IdP logout; browser-close persistence/revocation remain separate questions.

re-asd-files.title: re-asd-files
re-asd-files.observation: File security classification enum persists with each file; fields include unclassified/classified/secret/top_secret. This is a real security attribute, distinct from document-type classifier tags.

re-asd-file-dto.title: re-asd-file-dto
re-asd-file-dto.observation: File create/update/response schema carries classification; fileToDto includes classification for API transmission and list filtering.

re-asd-worker-attrs.title: re-asd-worker-attrs
re-asd-worker-attrs.observation: Ingestion carries effective security classification through config hashes, jobs, chunks, extracted assertions and output envelope; source classification floor is preserved.

re-asd-assertions.title: re-asd-assertions
re-asd-assertions.observation: Assertions persist classification and expressly ratchet up from source floor, never down; producer enforces that rule.

re-asd-markdown.title: re-asd-markdown
re-asd-markdown.observation: Only production v-html sink strips all input HTML with DOMPurify, parses markdown then sanitizes the generated HTML again; Vue templates otherwise escape bindings.

re-asd-validation.title: re-asd-validation
re-asd-validation.observation: Global Zod/OpenAPI validation constrains API inputs; unsupported or unconfigured JSON routes fail; binary/multipart gets explicit handling.

re-asd-file-bounds.title: re-asd-file-bounds
re-asd-file-bounds.observation: Upload rejects excessive declared Content-Length and uses configured multipart maximum; content is not passed as an OS shell command.

re-asd-race.title: re-asd-race
re-asd-race.observation: Atomic compare-and-set uploading-to-uploaded ensures only one concurrent finalize emits an event; corresponding repository tests explicitly exercise two concurrent finalizers.

re-asd-race-worker.title: re-asd-race-worker
re-asd-race-worker.observation: Job ownership/idempotency uses INSERT ON CONFLICT and conditional updates; workers do not rely on unprotected check-then-write for ownership.

re-asd-sql.title: re-asd-sql
re-asd-sql.observation: Drizzle array/data values are bound parameters; raw type identifiers are closed literal unions. Reviewed raw SQL function names in zone/units repositories are fixed internal allowlists.

re-asd-sql-mcp.title: re-asd-sql-mcp
re-asd-sql-mcp.observation: LLM tools expose only catalog mcp_allowed functions; names/types come from fixed metadata, values use SQLAlchemy bind params and tenant is injected/UUID validated, not arbitrary model SQL.

re-asd-parser-lock.title: re-asd-parser-lock
re-asd-parser-lock.observation: Delivered image dependency lock pins ingestion pipeline6010a2, Docling2.142.0, python-docx1.2.0, python-pptx1.0.2, openpyxl3.1.5, lxml6.1.3 and defusedxml0.7.1.

re-asd-codeql-allow.title: re-asd-codeql-allow
re-asd-codeql-allow.observation: All eleven raw Python sensitive-log alerts are explicitly reviewed false positives for casualty-plan/run correlation UUIDs, with @schwing approvals and Jira references; inspected representative source flows.

re-asd-codeql-run.title: re-asd-codeql-run
re-asd-codeql-run.observation: Successful CodeQL analysis of exact delivered b84b9af. Downloaded both raw SARIF artifacts: JavaScript/TypeScript0 results; Python11 reviewed sensitive-UUID false positives matching source allowlist; no reported SQL/command/XSS/XML result.

re-asd-ci-run.title: re-asd-ci-run
re-asd-ci-run.observation: Successful exact b84b9af build; emitted API coverage/request artifact, E2E results and per-image SBOM/Grype/ClamAV evidence. Separate CI run42102523383 also succeeds at this commit.

re-asd-vector.title: re-asd-vector
re-asd-vector.observation: Pod/node JSON collection has separate Loki sinks, persistent on-disk1GiB buffers and acknowledgement machinery; product logging survives collector backend disruption by buffering rather than requiring API-local spooling.

re-asd-retention.title: re-asd-retention
re-asd-retention.observation: Loki default retention is indefinite; central UDS identity stdout is included. Finite retention/bucket lifecycle overrides must preserve the stated minimum30months/5years policy.

re-asd-alerts.title: re-asd-alerts
re-asd-alerts.observation: Default Prometheus Kubernetes/workload/storage rules provide low-resource monitoring. Rule-specific audit75percent and named SA/ISSO receivers are separate configuration obligations.

re-asd-id-alerts.title: re-asd-id-alerts
re-asd-id-alerts.observation: Optional account/user/realm admin change alert templates exist, but detailedObservability alerts defaults off; mechanisms do not establish routing recipients.

re-asd-network.title: re-asd-network
re-asd-network.observation: UDS generates namespace ingress/egress default deny; app UDS Package declares authorized service and external flows rather than relying on each API to enforce network decisions.

re-asd-package.title: re-asd-package
re-asd-package.observation: UDS Package declaratively authorizes app/model/storage communication. Hosted model egress exists in actual candidate; local-only model requirement needs its selected profile.

re-asd-backup.title: re-asd-backup
re-asd-backup.observation: Velero resources scheduled daily, but snapshotsEnabled and snapshotVolumes false; this does not backup PostgreSQL/PVC application data.

re-asd-db.title: re-asd-db
re-asd-db.observation: Application database runtime uses dedicated PostgreSQL/PVC; source does not configure data backup/PITR or storage encryption. Bundled Keycloak database privilege is irrelevant to actual UDS-identity release.

re-asd-tests.title: re-asd-tests
re-asd-tests.observation: Core ships security validation/integration tasks; they are package tests rather than Navigator providing an in-product security-function verification service.

re-asd-xml-docling.title: re-asd-xml-docling
re-asd-xml-docling.observation: Locked Docling MSWord parser defines safe XML parser with resolve_entities=False, load_dtd=False, no_network=True and no DTD validation for chart XML.

re-asd-xml-docx.title: re-asd-xml-docx
re-asd-xml-docx.observation: Locked python-docx sets XMLParser(resolve_entities=False). Locked python-pptx1.0.2 wheel inspected with same setting; no huge_tree override.

re-asd-xml-openpyxl.title: re-asd-xml-openpyxl
re-asd-xml-openpyxl.observation: Official security guidance uses defusedxml to mitigate XML expansion; delivered lock includes it. Inspected exact3.1.5 wheel: optional defusedxml enabled default, replaces iterparse/fromstring; lxml parser also disables entities.

re-asd-xml-lxml.title: re-asd-xml-lxml
re-asd-xml-lxml.observation: lxml default huge_tree=False retains depth/text security restrictions and no_network=True. Inspected locked consumers do not opt into huge_tree.

re-asd-parser.title: re-asd-parser
re-asd-parser.observation: Actual locked pipeline routes PDF/DOCX/PPTX/HTML/text/XLSX/tabular/JSON; no arbitrary XML/XPath/signature endpoint. OfficeXML is still considered; parsers are secure upstream implementations.

re-asd-cookie.title: re-asd-cookie
re-asd-cookie.observation: Verified actual sharedCore Keycloak26.7.4: AUTH_SESSION_ID/KEYCLOAK_IDENTITY are FEDERATION/HttpOnly; KEYCLOAK_SESSION and AUTH_SESSION_ID_HASH are FEDERATION_JS noncredential sessioncoordination markers. These do not supply the authenticator.

re-asd-realm-env.title: re-asd-realm-env
re-asd-realm-env.observation: Core OTP_ENABLED=true renders OTP_FLOW_ENABLED and MFA_FLOW_ENABLED=REQUIRED in realm env; username/password subflow therefore requires the OTP flow. The raw realm placeholder fallback DISABLED is not the effective Helm default.

re-asd-artifact-frame.title: re-asd-artifact-frame
re-asd-artifact-frame.observation: Untrusted model HTML is isolated in sandbox=allow-scripts with NO allow-same-origin, denying access to parent DOM, cookies and storage; no browser plugin permissions granted.

re-asd-artifact-csp.title: re-asd-artifact-csp
re-asd-artifact-csp.observation: CSP is injected before any script: default-src none, object-src none, form-action none, base-uri none; browser artifact execution is isolated. Same-frame navigation residual is explicitly documented and is not parent-origin script execution.

re-asd-asd-overview.title: re-asd-asd-overview
re-asd-asd-overview.observation: Official cached ASD V6R5 Overview.pdf inside retained original DISA ZIP categorizes browser JavaScript/JScript/ECMAScript as Category3 mobile code allowed in browser; inspected extracted page8 text, not inferred modern mobile-code policy.

re-asd-pods.title: re-asd-pods
re-asd-pods.observation: Services use nonroot/read-only security contexts, config mounts/envSecret references and distinct runtime paths; actual release renderer selects UDS identity, not bundledKeycloak.

re-asd-web-image.title: re-asd-web-image
re-asd-web-image.observation: Multistage runtime ships compiled frontend assets only, deletes source maps, uses nginx runtime rather than development server; application source/build toolchain is separate.

re-asd-secret-generation.title: re-asd-secret-generation
re-asd-secret-generation.observation: Deployment generates database admin/app/OpenFGA passwords with openssl rand-hex24 when absent and preserves existingSecret values; actual credentials are external substitutions, not committed sampledefaults.

re-asd-id-admin-secret.title: re-asd-id-admin-secret
re-asd-id-admin-secret.observation: When enabled Core generates32character random admin password and retains existingSecret, rather than shipping a universal knownadminpassword.

re-asd-mtls.title: re-asd-mtls
re-asd-mtls.observation: Root namespace PeerAuthentication requires STRICT mutualTLS; certificates supply workload/device identity and periodic TLS reauthentication/rotation at mesh boundary.

re-asd-cookie-actual.title: re-asd-cookie-actual
re-asd-cookie-actual.observation: Verified actual sharedCore Keycloak26.7.4 source: cookie builder sets Secure from effective HTTPS/proxy context and HttpOnly from CookieScope; realm/request path-scoped. Core passes xforwarded proxy headers under HTTPSgateway.

re-asd-role-grants.title: re-asd-role-grants
re-asd-role-grants.observation: grantRole inserts actor audit then writes an OpenFGA role tuple; it does not require recentauthentication or change current JWT/session. Subject obtains the live role through future permissionchecks.

re-asd-live-authz.title: re-asd-live-authz
re-asd-live-authz.observation: Permissionchecks query OpenFGA for currentuser,target andrelation; memoization is request-scopedCLS only. An existing validtoken can use newlygranted rights on subsequentrequests; noauth_time/max_age constraint is checked.

re-kubernetes-release.title: re-kubernetes-release
re-kubernetes-release.observation: Latest successful Nov5 UDS push artifact2026.45.4-uds.1 identifies package commit d528b7f, Horizon b84b9af, Core1.14 and identity.mode=uds. Its build-info supplies immutable runtimeSource images; this supersedes the bundled-identity default candidate for this review.

re-kubernetes-postgres-env.title: re-kubernetes-postgres-env
re-kubernetes-postgres-env.observation: POSTGRES_USER and POSTGRES_PASSWORD are injected with env.valueFrom.secretKeyRef. Re-rendering after actual release apply_identity/stage transformations preserves both environment references; supported mesh or Secret RBAC does not change this delivery mechanism.

re-kubernetes-s3-configmap.title: re-kubernetes-s3-configmap
re-kubernetes-s3-configmap.observation: SeaweedFS s3.json contains accessKey/secretKey in a Kubernetes ConfigMap. Deployment mounts that ConfigMap read-only. Re-rendering actual UDS identity/runtime-image profile preserves this resource kind and sensitive fields; the eventual Zarf substitutions populate credentials.

re-kubernetes-profile-transform.title: re-kubernetes-profile-transform
re-kubernetes-profile-transform.observation: UDS identity transformation removes the bundled Keycloak component/secrets and edits OIDC/profile values, but does not replace the PostgreSQL secret-as-environment template or SeaweedFS credential ConfigMap. runtime_source.stage pins image fields and leaves those templates unchanged.

re-kubernetes-policy-code.title: re-kubernetes-policy-code
re-kubernetes-policy-code.observation: UDS Pepr mutates and validates non-root execution, no privilege escalation, restricted capabilities, seccomp/proc/SELinux settings for pod/main/init/ephemeral security contexts. Workload policy admission supplies actual least-privilege enforcement independently of a native PodSecurity configuration file.

re-kubernetes-policy-reference.title: re-kubernetes-policy-reference
re-kubernetes-policy-reference.observation: UDS documents Pepr admission as aligned with Pod Security Standards restricted profile plus mesh controls. It also lists specific not-yet-implemented Big Bang policies, so this is evidence of the implemented policy set, not an assertion that Pepr exactly equals every PSS/native-controller behavior.

re-kubernetes-fail-closed.title: re-kubernetes-fail-closed
re-kubernetes-fail-closed.observation: UDS Pepr onError=reject; zarf admission/watch namespace is excluded, and istio-system has an additional Ignore-failure webhook for bootstrap availability. Ordinary mission namespaces do not share that fail-open exception.

re-kubernetes-removed-gate.title: re-kubernetes-removed-gate
re-kubernetes-removed-gate.observation: Upstream Kubernetes lists PodSecurity feature gate stable/default true from1.25 through1.27; it is removed after1.27. A removed feature gate is not a valid setting, so requiring PodSecurity=true literally on1.28+ is obsolete, not a remediation action.

re-kubernetes-native-admission.title: re-kubernetes-native-admission
re-kubernetes-native-admission.observation: PodSecurity is the built-in validating admission controller stable since1.25 and among default-enabled admission plugins. Native enablement can still be explicitly overridden; source of a separate app package does not prove the exact host override or static-pod configuration.

re-kubernetes-supported-versions.title: re-kubernetes-supported-versions
re-kubernetes-supported-versions.observation: Pinned Core1.14 documentation covers supported non-EOL CNCF-conformant clusters and tests1.34/1.35/1.36 variants. This supports modern-version tailoring; it does not identify the actual MPN host version.

re-kubernetes-workload-sa.title: re-kubernetes-workload-sa
re-kubernetes-workload-sa.observation: Application chart creates named service accounts and explicitly controls automountServiceAccountToken. That supports workload isolation but does not establish the separate controller-manager --use-service-account-credentials flag.

re-platform-delivered-profile.title: re-platform-delivered-profile
re-platform-delivered-profile.observation: Successful UDS publication2026.45.4-uds.1 records package d528, app b84b9af, Core1.14.0, identity.mode=uds issuer https://sso.uds.dev/realms/uds and12 digest-pinned images; no bundled Keycloak image. This is delivered artifact evidence, not assumed default profile.

re-platform-realm.title: re-platform-realm
re-platform-realm.observation: UDS realm provides user/admin event logging and JSON event listener, native enabled/account roles, strong default password policy. Inactivity disable workflow defaults false; terms required-action enablement defaults false; CRL checking defaults false with OCSP checking true. No password blacklist or24h-min-age/eight-character-distance in passwordPolicy.

re-platform-realm-params.title: re-platform-realm-params
re-platform-realm-params.observation: Core exposes realmInitEnv overrides for ACCOUNT_INACTIVITY_DAYS, TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS_ENABLED and X509_CRL_CHECKING_ENABLED; these are commented/unset in shipped defaults. detailedObservability.alerts.enabled defaults false.

re-platform-flow.title: re-platform-flow
re-platform-flow.observation: Application Package CR specifies ambient mesh, explicit ingress, IntraNamespace allows and workload-scoped external egress, including shared UDS issuer rules in uds mode. Those are enforceable declared policies; hosted inference requirement mismatch does not mean no platform flow control exists.

re-platform-notify.title: re-platform-notify
re-platform-notify.observation: Account/admin modification alert PrometheusRules are emitted only if detailedObservability.alerts.enabled; source includes alerts but requires enablement.

re-platform-falco.title: re-platform-falco
re-platform-falco.observation: Falco/Sidekick sends findings to stdout/Loki; direct Alertmanager delivery is commented out. No required recipient delivery is established by the pipeline profile.

re-platform-monitor.title: re-platform-monitor
re-platform-monitor.observation: Default Kubernetes storage/system alerts enabled; alertmanager exists but no SA/ISSO receiver routes or exact75percent audit repository rule are set in this file.

re-platform-verify.title: re-platform-verify
re-platform-verify.observation: Privileged UDS tasks include validate-packages and e2e-tests; the latter exercises live Keycloak account setup, network policies and Pepr controls. Source establishes an on-demand verification implementation, not merely health endpoints. No new execution claimed.

re-platform-verify-security.title: re-platform-verify-security
re-platform-verify-security.observation: Executable security verification asserts unsafe privileged/root pod requests are denied and safe security contexts work. Such tests are callable by operator, satisfying an on-demand verification path rather than requiring a distinct app test subsystem.

re-platform-trust.title: re-platform-trust
re-platform-trust.observation: Actual default IdP trust source is official DoD approved external PKI chains ZIP, with required SHA256 check and expired-certificate rejection before populating truststore. It is not an unspecified empty mechanism.

re-platform-trust-boundary.title: re-platform-trust-boundary
re-platform-trust-boundary.observation: Core documents default DoD UNCLASS IdP certificate bundle and explicit custom-image process to replace it. Shared platform trust defaults are inspectable; gateway/custom trust overrides are separately owner-managed.

re-platform-trust-distribution.title: re-platform-trust-distribution
re-platform-trust-distribution.observation: Operator distributes selected custom/DoD/curated public trust to UDS components. Custom/public global trust-bundle inclusion is opt-in; default identity DoD truststore is a separate mechanism.

re-platform-init-resource.title: re-platform-init-resource
re-platform-init-resource.observation: UDS identity transformation clears migrations.extraDatabases and removes bundled Keycloak/provisioner components, thereby removing create-databases and wait-for-Keycloak init containers. Reproduced delivered chart captures contain16 main/init containers, all with nonempty resource settings.

re-platform-external-storage.title: re-platform-external-storage
re-platform-external-storage.observation: Production UDS requires operator-provisioned storage, TLS and identity database. The Horizon profile does not specify MPN cluster datastore/keystore disk encryption or Zarf-init settings; commercial Gallatin AWS IaC is a different deployment boundary.

re-platform-id-audit.title: re-platform-id-audit
re-platform-id-audit.observation: JSON listener emits platform user/admin events to stdout for Vector/Loki collection. UDS identity selected by delivered artifact makes this applicable to Horizon rather than requiring its own duplicated forwarding.

re-platform-audit-selector.title: re-platform-audit-selector
re-platform-audit-selector.observation: Platform Grafana requires UDS SSO and maps /UDS Core/Admin to Admin, /UDS Core/Auditor to Viewer and unmatched users to Unauthorized; platform configuration is separated from ordinary Horizon tenant users.

re-platform-classification-fields.title: re-platform-classification-fields
re-platform-classification-fields.observation: Delivered app source defines classification_level enum and files.classification field; chunks/assertions reuse it. A real data-security taxonomy exists; API/database audit coverage, not taxonomy discovery, is the remaining concern.

re-platform-revocation-cache.title: re-platform-revocation-cache
re-platform-revocation-cache.observation: Exact Core Keycloak26.7.4 CertificateValidator CRLFileLoader uses CrlStorageProvider cache, but checkRevocationStatus invokes it only when CRL checking enabled. OCSP path invokes online provider check. Pinned UDS realm defaults CRL checkingfalse, OCSPtrue; therefore a cache exists in product, but its required disconnected validation path is not selected by that default.

re-platform-delivered-jwt.title: re-platform-delivered-jwt
re-platform-delivered-jwt.observation: Delivered API uses jose jwtVerify against selected issuer/audience/JWKS; expiration verification is enabled. It does not introspect each token or implement role-change/privilege-escalation step-up triggers.

re-platform-delivered-browser-auth.title: re-platform-delivered-browser-auth
re-platform-delivered-browser-auth.observation: Delivered browser OIDC client follows provider session/token lifecycle with code/PKCE automatic silent renewal; no role-change/privilege-escalation prompt=login/max_age policy is configured here.

re-web-actual-release.title: re-web-actual-release
re-web-actual-release.observation: Successful UDS push release2026.45.4-uds.1 build-info and platform-contract bind application b84b9af/build19710, package d528b7f, Core1.14.0, identity.mode=uds issuerhttps://sso.uds.dev/realms/uds. No bundled Keycloak is delivered. Web delivered platform digest76d8dfbca65b27221b6a3c2588763b14dc058e965ea62507fa71130067522ae6.

re-web-base-pin.title: re-web-base-pin
re-web-base-pin.observation: Web uses nginx-fips:1.31.8 pinnedsha256:72d1e862659a14e95b0a47cd85e1cfc3ecd44ce890215be1ea4a3bcc961b0d7f. Dockerfile replaces conf.d/default.conf but inherits /etc/nginx/nginx.conf.

re-web-base-config.title: re-web-base-config
re-web-base-config.observation: Exact pinned nginx base filesystem exported without executing image: root nginx.conf worker_processes auto, worker_connections1024, keepalive_timeout65, sendfile on, main accesslog includes remote_addr/remote_user/request/status/Referer/UserAgent/XForwardedFor. Access/error log paths are symlinks to stdout/stderr. Root config contains no server_tokens off. Image-build SBOM identifies nginx-mainline/config1.31.8-r1 and CMVP5132 materials.

re-web-web-values.title: re-web-web-values
re-web-web-values.observation: Delivered web chart exposes port3000, mounts conf.d static server block and public runtime config read-only; separate scratch emptyDirs; no application data PVC. Runtime CPU50m request,memory64Mi request/128Mi limit; immutable assets1year cache,gzip. ConfigMap server block leaves inherited main nginx connection/log settings intact.

re-web-web-source.title: re-web-web-source
re-web-web-source.observation: Static nginx serves compiled SPA, try_files index fallback; no proxy_pass, administrative/account endpoint, CGI or upload write handler. Source server block does not set server_tokens off; runtime chart replaces only the server config.

re-web-web-image.title: re-web-web-image
re-web-web-image.observation: Multistage final web image copies only built frontend distribution and nginx server config; source maps removed. Runtime main config and logging/worker defaults inherited from pinned nginx base.

re-web-web-runtime.title: re-web-web-runtime
re-web-web-runtime.observation: Dedicated pod/container has non-root, read-only root filesystem and serviceaccount/no escalation settings, explicit containerPort. Static config/data layouts are immutable and runtime scratch mounts are separated.

re-web-service.title: re-web-service
re-web-service.observation: ClusterIP Service binds explicitly selected service port and named target port http to dedicated pod label selectors; neither hostNetwork nor wildcard hostPort is introduced.

re-web-package.title: re-web-package
re-web-package.observation: UDS ambient Package routes /api to API,/ws to NATS,static root to web through tenant gateway. Actual UDS identity branch declares shared issuer/client registration and omits local Keycloak exposure; selected namespace horizon-uds.

re-web-gateway.title: re-web-gateway
re-web-gateway.observation: Dedicated tenant gateway binds HTTPS443, HTTP80 redirect, TLS1.3 default; separate route roles and downstream/upstream protocols. Static nginx is not also the gateway proxy.

re-web-headers.title: re-web-headers
re-web-headers.observation: Core removes server and x-envoy-upstream-service-time response headers at ingress. It does not rewrite nginx default error response bodies, so body version disclosure remains a narrower configuration issue.

re-web-accesslog.title: re-web-accesslog
re-web-accesslog.observation: Mesh/gateway access logging is enabled tostdout, path normalization and sanitized certificate details configured. Default log format includes client-chain and network endpoints.

re-web-istio-log-format.title: re-web-istio-log-format
re-web-istio-log-format.observation: Official default access-log fields include X-Forwarded-For, request ID, User-Agent, upstream host and both downstream network endpoints when accessLogFormat is not overridden.

re-web-http2.title: re-web-http2
re-web-http2.observation: Official Istio protocol-selection docs: HTTPS gateways advertiseHTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2. Without explicit upstream protocol selection, gateway forwards upstream usingHTTP/1.1. Client-facing HTTP2 and backend translation are separate control questions.

re-web-realm.title: re-web-realm
re-web-realm.observation: Shared UDS realm uses 15character/class/history/expiry password policy, enabled UPDATE_PASSWORD/reset-password flows, X509/OTP and account enabled/disabled mechanisms. No password blacklist provider/update policy is selected; local CRL checking defaultsfalse (OCSPtrue).

re-web-realm-flows.title: re-web-realm-flows
re-web-realm-flows.observation: Chart maps OTP_ENABLED=true into OTP_FLOW_ENABLED=REQUIRED and MFA_FLOW_ENABLED=REQUIRED. Reading raw realm placeholder defaultDISABLED without Helm substitution would miss mandatory username/password MFA. Chart also maps optional account-inactivity workflow only if configured.

re-web-identity-values.title: re-web-identity-values
re-web-identity-values.observation: Selected Core realmAuthFlows defaults OTPtrue,X509true,USERNAME_PASSWORDtrue; account inactivity workflow opt-in, detailedObservability alerts off. Provider administration/flow settings—not static nginx—own identity security controls.

re-web-identity-doc.title: re-web-identity-doc
re-web-identity-doc.observation: Core docs identify defaultOTP as required MFA for username/password and CAC certificate+PIN as normal MFA path. OTP software may run on a separate approved authenticator device; exact device strength is mission policy.

re-web-trust.title: re-web-trust
re-web-trust.observation: Truststore build downloads approved DoD external-PKI archive with required pinned SHA verification, filters email/software certs and rejects expired certs; copies only selected CA material for Keycloak. Trust material is not an unspecified empty mechanism.

re-web-trust-build.title: re-web-trust-build
re-web-trust-build.observation: Default CA ZIP URL is dl.dod.cyber.mil DoD approved external PKI chains. The generated DoD CA material, realm and FIPS libraries are packaged into identity-config image consumed by Core.

re-web-logs.title: re-web-logs
re-web-logs.observation: Delivered b84 API root bindings have request/trace/span identifiers but no authenticated user subject; serializer records status and network address with secret redaction. Some domain audit tables have actor but do not cover every web/API event.

re-web-jwt.title: re-web-jwt
re-web-jwt.observation: Delivered API uses jose jwtVerify with issuer/audience/signature/expiry; no per-request introspection/session-revocation lookup or initial-source-IP binding. Delegated IdP logout ends SSO but not validation of an already issued bearer token.

re-web-auth.title: re-web-auth
re-web-auth.observation: Explicit logout wipes user/local auth state and calls IdP signout. It is implemented; residual is outstanding-token revocation rather than a missing logout button.

re-web-vector.title: re-web-vector
re-web-vector.observation: Central collector ships pod/node logs to Loki with buffering. No actual75percent audit-capacity/processing-failure SA/ISSO route is declared by this Horizon package.

re-web-alerts.title: re-web-alerts
re-web-alerts.observation: Account/admin-modification alert templates are conditional on detailedObservability.alerts.enabled; they do not automatically prove audit-tampering/processing-failure notifications to named roles.

re-web-cookie-types.title: re-web-cookie-types
re-web-cookie-types.observation: Correct CoreKeycloak26.7.4 marks AUTH_SESSION_ID and KEYCLOAK_IDENTITY FEDERATION(HttpOnly), while KEYCLOAK_SESSION and short-lived KC_AUTH_SESSION_HASH are FEDERATION_JS for session coordination. They are not credential bearer cookies; generic blanket all-cookie remediation would break product behavior.

re-web-cookie-provider.title: re-web-cookie-provider
re-web-cookie-provider.observation: Cookie builder obtains Secure from effective HTTPS context, HttpOnly from cookie scope and realm/request path; credential and noncredential scopes are deliberate upstream product distinctions.

re-web-mobile-policy.title: re-web-mobile-policy
re-web-mobile-policy.observation: Official included ASD V6R5 Overview.pdf page8 explicitly classifies browser JavaScript/ECMAScript as permitted Category3 mobile code. Browser JavaScript follows the Category 3 applicability provisions.

re-web-artifact-csp.title: re-web-artifact-csp
re-web-artifact-csp.observation: Model-authored HTML receives CSP default-src none,object-src none,form-action none; scripts execute in sandbox allow-scripts iframe without same-origin access. No unmediated plugin/ActiveX execution. Same-frame navigation is a documented residual, not evidence that browserJS is uncategorized.

re-web-artifact-frame.title: re-web-artifact-frame
re-web-artifact-frame.observation: Iframe sandbox lacks allow-same-origin and denies permissions/referrers; browser mediates code execution and isolates from parent cookies/storage.

re-web-id-statefulset.title: re-web-id-statefulset
re-web-id-statefulset.observation: CoreKeycloak26.7.4 startup enables featuresfips, fips-modestrict, proxy-headersxforwarded, http-enabledtrue behind selected HTTPSgateway; selected truststore paths mounted separately.

re-web-secure-generator.title: re-web-secure-generator
re-web-secure-generator.observation: Session id generator uses SecureRandom with SESSION_ID_BYTES18 and URL-safe base64 output. This is144raw entropybits before optional affinity filtering; comment explicitly preserves128bits after filtering. Output alphabet includes upper/lower/digits; no caller-selected IDs.

re-web-session-factory.title: re-web-session-factory
re-web-session-factory.observation: The actual user-session cache factory selects SecretGenerator.SECURE_ID_GENERATOR for persistent/cache or volatile variants. Source ties high-entropy generator to session creation, rather than infer from a generic unused utility.

re-web-api-auth.title: re-web-api-auth
re-web-api-auth.observation: Delivered API validates named OIDCsubject, resolves tenant and JITprovisions individualuser before protected operations. Resource grants remain separate from shared service principals.

re-appserver-release.title: re-appserver-release
re-appserver-release.observation: The successful UDS push packaged2026.45.4-uds.1 records trusted Horizonb84b9af/build19710, packagecommitd528b7f, UDS Core 1.14.0 and platformContract identity.mode=uds, issuerhttps://sso.uds.dev/realms/uds. The actual delivered profile omits bundled Keycloak. Source-default bundled realm is not the delivered identity boundary.

re-appserver-coreidentity.title: re-appserver-coreidentity
re-appserver-coreidentity.observation: Core 1.14 default enables OTP and X509, sets concurrent per-user limit0(unlimited), leaves inactivity workflow opt-in, includes explicit truststorepaths and optional alert enablement.

re-appserver-flowrender.title: re-appserver-flowrender
re-appserver-flowrender.observation: Chart maps OTP_ENABLED=true to OTP_FLOW_ENABLED=REQUIRED and MFA_FLOW_ENABLED=REQUIRED, and maps X509 auth to enabled alternate flow. Raw realm interpolation fallbacks alone are not the final rendered flow.

re-appserver-realm.title: re-appserver-realm
re-appserver-realm.observation: Realm provides X509UPN/custom-attribute mapping, OCSP checking defaulttrue/failclosed, localCRLfalse, OTP browser flow, user/admin events, ten-minute idle. Consent required action defaultsdisabled; inactivity workflow disabled unless configured; sessionsunlimited default.

re-appserver-trust.title: re-appserver-trust
re-appserver-trust.observation: Image trust builder defaults officialDoD approved externalPKI trust chains ZIP, requires SHA256 verification, converts .cer files, excludes configured certificate categories, and includes non-expired certificates. This is actual source provisioning, not a generic claim that trust is unknowable.

re-appserver-trustsync.title: re-appserver-trustsync
re-appserver-trustsync.observation: Identityconfig sync copies generated certs into Keycloak conf/truststores and installs realm/plugin/theme configuration. FIPS libraries are copied when configured.

re-appserver-identitygateway.title: re-appserver-identitygateway
re-appserver-identitygateway.observation: UDS routes privateKeycloak paths away from public tenantgateway, exposes admin access separately, strips user-supplied clientcertificate header and injects downstreamcert for delegated X509 handling.

re-appserver-terms.title: re-appserver-terms
re-appserver-terms.observation: UDS theme includes mandatory USG notice and explicit acknowledgement UI, but this template is reached only when the terms required action is enabled.

re-appserver-auth.title: re-appserver-auth
re-appserver-auth.observation: Every protected request validates OIDC claims and single tenantgroup, resolves stable sub->localuser/tenant, and sets trusted userId/tenantId CLS context. Pending/no-role users are denied.

re-appserver-authorization.title: re-appserver-authorization
re-appserver-authorization.observation: Authorization derives user, objecttype/relation/objectId and contextual tuples, passes the pinned model to OpenFGA and uses a per-request cache keyed by user+object+relation+tuples.

re-appserver-tenantresolver.title: re-appserver-tenantresolver
re-appserver-tenantresolver.observation: Tenant-scoped authorization targets derive from authenticated tenantId CLS rather than caller-selected arbitrary tenancy.

re-appserver-schemaattributes.title: re-appserver-schemaattributes
re-appserver-schemaattributes.observation: Branch records automatically derive tenant_id from trusted app.tenant_id context; composite ancestry/tenantkeys and user audit fields preserve objectsecurity context. Application tenancy is an actual security attribute, not merely an arbitrary label.

re-appserver-piiprofile.title: re-appserver-piiprofile
re-appserver-piiprofile.observation: Users have tenant/identity and ordinary profile fields under RLS. No explicit per-PII-element authorized-processing or processing-purpose tag is configured in this schema.

re-appserver-roleaudit.title: re-appserver-roleaudit
re-appserver-roleaudit.observation: Role grant/revocation writes an actor+subject+tenant+action+role audit record, transactionally coupled with mutation. Failed preconditions throw before insert; failed transaction paths do not retain successful audit rows.

re-appserver-auditfields.title: re-appserver-auditfields
re-appserver-auditfields.observation: Appendonly permission audit table records actor_user_id, subject_user_id, tenant_id, action, role and timestamp. This is valid audit evidence even though it is a database record rather than Pino JSON.

re-appserver-logger.title: re-appserver-logger
re-appserver-logger.observation: Pino records stable serviceidentity, trace/requestIDs, requestmethod/URL and outcome, with secretredaction. Its commonbindings do not attach authenticated userId; not every per-domain failure can be assigned to a user from that record alone.

re-appserver-denials.title: re-appserver-denials
re-appserver-denials.observation: Deniedpermissions return403; unexpected resolutionfailures log permission/error but do not attach actor. Source distinguishes missing denied-domain audit from existing successful role change audit.

re-appserver-logaccess.title: re-appserver-logaccess
re-appserver-logaccess.observation: Grafana local login disabled; UDSgroups map Admin/Auditor to Admin/Viewer and unmatched groups are rejected. Runtime log configuration is Kubernetes-managed outside application users.

re-appserver-logging.title: re-appserver-logging
re-appserver-logging.observation: Vector collects pod/node records with namespace/app/container/host identifiers, acknowledged diskbuffers and Loki sinks, exports internal metrics and is monitored. It collects process/container identity independent of Horizonrequest actors.

re-appserver-alerts.title: re-appserver-alerts
re-appserver-alerts.observation: Core enables storage/workload/Prometheus defaultalerts and Alertmanager. This baseline does not configure a dedicated 75 percent audit storage threshold or actual SA/ISSO receiver.

re-appserver-identityalerts.title: re-appserver-identityalerts
re-appserver-identityalerts.observation: Identity realm/user/admin alert definitions exist behind detailedObservability.alerts.enabled; they do not automatically enable alerts or define operational receivers.

re-appserver-falco.title: re-appserver-falco
re-appserver-falco.observation: Falco/Sidekick detects runtime behavior and sends events toLoki, but Alertmanager routing is commented and no direct automated permissionrevocation/responsetrigger is configured.

re-appserver-podsecurity.title: re-appserver-podsecurity
re-appserver-podsecurity.observation: Admission restricts privileges/non-root/escalation/capabilities with explicitexemptions. This supplies secureapplication server operation and a preventionmechanism, but does not itself integrate Falcointrusionevents into accesscontrol.

re-appserver-logout.title: re-appserver-logout
re-appserver-logout.observation: Explicitlogout captures IdP signoutcontext, wipes localOIDC/sessionstate then invokes signoutRedirect. This is a delegated interactive logout implementation, not an absence of logout.

re-appserver-jwt.title: re-appserver-jwt
re-appserver-jwt.observation: ProtectedAPI verifies JWTsignature/issuer/audience/expiry offline. There is no per-request session revocation check; immediate bearer credential invalidation is a residual beyond ending the IdP/browser interactive session.

re-appserver-storage.title: re-appserver-storage
re-appserver-storage.observation: Application package requests a persistentvolume with empty/default storageClass; this source does not choose the MPN host disk/CSI encryption or offline backupimplementation.

re-appserver-gwtls.title: re-appserver-gwtls
re-appserver-gwtls.observation: UDS HTTPS ingress uses operator-supplied TLS Secret and rootminimumTLS; actual leaf certificate issuer/class is supplied outside Horizon package.

re-appserver-webmobile.title: re-appserver-webmobile
re-appserver-webmobile.observation: Multistage immutable frontend image copies compiled assets; clientJavaScript is served to browser, not installed/executed by an application server plugin/mobile code interface.

re-appserver-clustering.title: re-appserver-clustering
re-appserver-clustering.observation: The generic service chart implements Kubernetes Deployment replicaCount, optional autoscaling/v2 HPA, readiness/liveness probes and Service routing. This is a clustering/failover capability; MAC I actual redundancy requires its selected deployment configuration.

re-appserver-privateinputs.title: re-appserver-privateinputs
re-appserver-privateinputs.observation: Delivered platform-contract defines Core and identity but no data classification/MAC designation, MPN storage provider or gateway certificate chain. These organizational/provider selections cannot be recovered by treating the unused source template as the final deployment.

re-appserver-idlistener.title: re-appserver-idlistener
re-appserver-idlistener.observation: Actual UDS identity listener handles both UserEvent and AdminEvent, serializes original event fields plus event type and UTC timestamp, and prints JSON to stdout. Vector can collect the actual provider records directly; no bundled identity database forwarder is needed.

re-appserver-loginmask.title: re-appserver-loginmask
re-appserver-loginmask.observation: The delegated UDS login theme renders the credential input with type=password and autocomplete=off. Masking is implemented at the actual interactive authentication boundary.

re-database-release.title: re-database-release
re-database-release.observation: Successful UDS push42114745685 packages2026.45.4-uds.1; platform-contract selects shared UDS identity/Core1.14.0, no bundled Keycloak image. Build-info identifies appb84b9af/build19710 and Postgres digest3431665ea7f0c2dfe4bef9673aac6221a58bdf910251857123b7fb363cbb030e from source9d3725b0/run41699186459.

re-database-postgres-values.title: re-database-postgres-values
re-database-postgres-values.observation: Postgres chart args preload pgaudit and disable JIT; no pgaudit.log, native connection/disconnection logging, full log prefix, password policy hooks, session disconnect policy or encryption StorageClass selected. PVC uses host default StorageClass.

re-database-postgres-pod.title: re-database-postgres-pod
re-database-postgres-pod.observation: Dedicated PostgreSQL container/PVC and ClusterIP SQL service; PGDATA persists separately from read-only image. Native credentials from a managed Secret; generated initdb config in PGDATA. No human SQL login route is publicly exposed by Package.

re-database-machine-secrets.title: re-database-machine-secrets
re-database-machine-secrets.observation: Service/admin DB passwords generated with openssl rand -hex24 when not supplied, retained from existing Secrets on upgrade; app/openfga/admin are explicit deployment identities, not per-human accounts.

re-database-package-network.title: re-database-package-network
re-database-package-network.observation: UDS ambient mesh enrolls horizon namespace and controls SQL connectivity through namespace policy. Public exposes API/web/NATS and bundledKeycloak only when selected; no public PostgreSQL endpoint.

re-database-role.title: re-database-role
re-database-role.observation: Creates/updates separate horizon_app LOGIN password role; grants DML/schema usage, no superuser or BYPASSRLS. No CONNECTION LIMIT, VALID UNTIL, password-check hook or SET ROLE escalation path.

re-database-extension.title: re-database-extension
re-database-extension.observation: Migration creates pgAudit extension but catches unavailable errors; no session/object audit event settings are enabled by this migration.

re-database-cls.title: re-database-cls
re-database-cls.observation: Authenticated tenant and user are set transaction-locally as app.tenant_id/app.user_id. Pool reuse does not retain another request identity.

re-database-rls.title: re-database-rls
re-database-rls.observation: RLS predicates bind rows to transaction tenant context; tenant labels are separate from the persisted classification labels.

re-database-permission-audit.title: re-database-permission-audit
re-database-permission-audit.observation: Append-only role-change records carry tenant, individual actor/subject, grant/revoke action and timestamp; database-specific admin auditing remains distinct.

re-database-flag-audit.title: re-database-flag-audit
re-database-flag-audit.observation: Security-definer feature flag audit triggers record actor from app.user_id, action/old/new values and reason; demonstrates application/database-trigger auditing can meet a defined event requirement without pgAudit for that event.

re-database-labels.title: re-database-labels
re-database-labels.observation: Actual product taxonomy exists: classification_level enum unclassified/classified/secret/top_secret; files.classification persists labels.

re-database-chunk-labels.title: re-database-chunk-labels
re-database-chunk-labels.observation: Derived chunks persist classification metadata; assertion schema also persists classification with producer no-downgrade intent.

re-database-label-transport.title: re-database-label-transport
re-database-label-transport.observation: Typed request/response schemas expose, validate and return classification values; labels remain bound to returned file objects rather than being dropped on transit.

re-database-label-writes.title: re-database-label-writes
re-database-label-writes.observation: Metadata update/replace writes classification via repository and returns resulting row; no independent append-only classification-change audit event is emitted here. Ordinary access/status logging is not a before/after label audit.

re-database-query-context.title: re-database-query-context
re-database-query-context.observation: API service uses database pool with12-second statement_timeout and logs startup/close. This limits query duration, not DB per-role concurrent sessions or all connection idle lifetime.

re-database-tracing.title: re-database-tracing
re-database-tracing.observation: Optional SQL tracing carries parameterized query identity, db.namespace and outcome, excluding bind values. Config defaults tracing off, so it is not an enabled universal SQL audit equivalent.

re-database-config.title: re-database-config
re-database-config.observation: OpenTelemetry tracing defaults false, and SQL SSL default disabled under intended ambient mesh. No native DB certificate-auth/cache mechanism is configured.

re-database-vector.title: re-database-vector
re-database-vector.observation: Vector offloads container/node logs with workload labels to centralized Loki. Collection preserves emitted records; it does not create absent successful SQL events.

re-database-log-access.title: re-database-log-access
re-database-log-access.observation: UDS Grafana disables local login and maps identity groups to Admin/Viewer; protected logs can supply privileged review without DBMS-local audit dashboard.

re-database-mtls.title: re-database-mtls
re-database-mtls.observation: UDS root STRICT mesh policy authenticates/encrypts enrolled workload hops independently of PostgreSQL native TLS.

re-database-alerts.title: re-database-alerts
re-database-alerts.observation: Core enables general cluster/storage monitoring; candidate source does not add a DB audit-volume75% rule or specific audit-failure/tamper notification receiver.

re-database-storage.title: re-database-storage
re-database-storage.observation: UDS provisions external storage/operator services and supplied trust material; source does not identify actual MPN disk encryption settings or approved roots. Do not substitute unrelated Gallatin AWS infrastructure for MPN.

re-database-pgaudit.title: re-database-pgaudit
re-database-pgaudit.observation: pgAudit supports selectable session/object events and role/DDL/read/write classes; preloading/extension creation alone does not select classes. Default session audit setting is none.

re-database-pg-log.title: re-database-pg-log
re-database-pg-log.observation: PostgreSQL emits server errors to stderr by default; ERROR severity identifies failed/denied SQL and log_min_error_statement includes the failing command. Successful connection/disconnection logging requires explicit settings.

re-database-actual-image.title: re-database-actual-image
re-database-actual-image.observation: Static export of exact delivered PostgreSQL image confirms inherited entrypoint has no audit override, PostgreSQL18 sample defaults connection logging empty/disconnections off/prefix timestampPID; actual image has FIPS provider and enabled OpenSSL configuration. File hashes and SBOM details preserved in database-image-inspection.json.

re-database-pg-wal.title: re-database-pg-wal
re-database-pg-wal.observation: Native WAL preserves crash-recovery state in durable data storage; independent backup/PITR is a separate recovery capability and not required merely to preserve diagnostics/state on a process failure.

re-database-pg-roles.title: re-database-pg-roles
re-database-pg-roles.observation: PostgreSQL roles support per-role connection limits and password expiration; unset lifetime/connection limits are not inherited from Keycloak.

re-aaa-release.title: re-aaa-release
re-aaa-release.observation: Successful UDS publication artifact horizon-release-2026.45.4-uds.1 platform-contract.json selects identity.mode=uds, issuer https://sso.uds.dev/realms/uds, Core1.14.0; build-info.json enumerates12 deliveredimages and no bundled Keycloak.

re-aaa-realm.title: re-aaa-realm
re-aaa-realm.observation: Realm has failureFactor3, permanentLockout true, maxTemporaryLockouts0; password length15,upper/lower/digit,special2,history5 and expiry60days; jsonlog listener emits user/admin events. Browser has password and X509 alternative authentication; X509MFA defaultdisabled. Account-inactivity workflow optionaldisabled; no minimum-age/difference/blacklist policy selected. Recovery flow requires reset-password.

re-aaa-values.title: re-aaa-values
re-aaa-values.observation: Core uses identity-config0.32, X509/OTP enabled, username/password enabled; X509_MFA false, inactivity flag unset, detailed-observability alertingdisabled. Insecure admin password generation disabled. Truststore includes UDS bundle and serviceaccount CA separately from configimage truststore.

re-aaa-ca-build.title: re-aaa-ca-build
re-aaa-ca-build.observation: Build imports official unclass-dod_approved_external_pkis_trust_chains.zip only after pinned SHA256 verification; excludes EMAIL/SW authorities and expiredcertificates.

re-aaa-ca-image.title: re-aaa-ca-image
re-aaa-ca-image.observation: Identity config image builds official DoDCA trust bundle/cert directory and copies it into delivered image, along with realm/theme/plugins.

re-aaa-ca-sync.title: re-aaa-ca-sync
re-aaa-ca-sync.observation: Config init sync copies certs into /opt/keycloak/conf/truststores plus realm/plugin/theme; when FIPS enabled also copies FIPS libraries. Thus approvedCA defaults have executable source, not an unspecified empty trust mechanism.

re-aaa-json-events.title: re-aaa-json-events
re-aaa-json-events.observation: Listener serializes user/admin identity events to stdout with actor/source/time/detail, suitable for UDS Vector collection; does not itself pushSA/ISSO notification messages.

re-aaa-alerts.title: re-aaa-alerts
re-aaa-alerts.observation: Optional PrometheusRules alert on realm/user/admin modifications only if detailedObservability.alerts.enabled; rule availability is not configured delivery toSA/ISSO.

re-aaa-recovery-ui.title: re-aaa-recovery-ui
re-aaa-recovery-ui.observation: Recovery/update-password UI requires new password and confirmation; renders provider policy errors and defaults logout-other-sessions checked.

re-aaa-sso-boundary.title: re-aaa-sso-boundary
re-aaa-sso-boundary.observation: PlatformKeycloak admin/public ingress is separate, sanitized clientcertificate header forwarded from gateway; certificate access available but optional at default browser boundary.

re-aaa-security-isolation.title: re-aaa-security-isolation
re-aaa-security-isolation.observation: Keycloak runtime configured strictFIPS, dedicated serviceidentity and file/volume paths; sensitive data stored within protected service/persistent/externalDB boundary. OS/storage protection is inherited, not a requirement to add independent application encryption.

re-aaa-flow-env.title: re-aaa-flow-env
re-aaa-flow-env.observation: Default OTP_ENABLED=true generates OTP_FLOW_ENABLED and MFA_FLOW_ENABLED REQUIRED; X509 remains ALTERNATIVE and X509_MFA disabled. Do not infer OTPbypass solely from conditional-flow name or CONFIGURE_TOTP defaultActionfalse.

mpn-identity-values.observation: Core1.14 chart default fields: realmInitEnv.SSO_SESSION_MAX_PER_USER="0"; ACCOUNT_INACTIVITY_DAYS unset; terms enabled unset; detailedObservability.alerts.enabled=false; realmAuthFlows username/password/X509/OTPtrue, X509MFAfalse. Gallatin owns these settings on MPN, independent of DU managedIL5/IL6 clusters.

mpn-identity-mapping.observation: realmInitEnv keys are prefixed REALM_ into realm import environment; ACCOUNT_INACTIVITY_DAYS>0 sets enabled true. realmAuthFlows controls required/disabled MFA/password/X509 execution variables. No further vendor service is needed to set these controls.

mpn-identity-init-only.observation: realmInitEnv and realmAuthFlows are initial realm import inputs. Existing realm is persisted in DB; redeploying Secret does not change it. Core documents equivalent Keycloak AdminConsole settings. Use controlled non-destructive AdminAPI/console update and persist the desired bundle override; do not advise tearing down production identity.

mpn-identity-inactivity.observation: Set realmInitEnv.ACCOUNT_INACTIVITY_DAYS="35" before firstimport. Existingrealm: uds Workflows >disable-inactive-users enabled=true, disable-user stepafter35d; realm-admin excluded by shipped workflow. Source establishes exact operator action without asking DU to prove it.

mpn-identity-realm.observation: Knowndefaults: idle600sec,maxlifespan36000sec; sessionlimit0; permanentlockout threshold3; default passwords length15/classes/history5/expiry60. CRL cachechecking disabled, OCSP checking enabled/failclosed; no eightcharacter-distance/24h minchange interval/selecteddenylist. Explicit source gaps are config/tailoring work, not Unknown.

mpn-identity-banner.observation: Shipped theme already contains USG InformationSystem notice/consent text and acknowledgementUI. Enable realmInitEnv.TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS_ENABLED=true; review mission applicability rather than build another banner.

mpn-identity-crl.observation: Core includes an OCI CRL-volume packaging script and override example: mount current CRLs, set X509_CRL_CHECKING_ENABLED true and filepaths. Strictfreshness requires X509_CRL_ABORT_IF_NON_UPDATED=true; default examplefalse permits expiredCRLs. ImageVolume needs Kubernetes feature support; no customKeycloakcode/image required.

mpn-identity-crl-script.observation: Gallatin can package approved CRLs with supplied script and deliver updated OCI dataimage beforeCoreidentity component; mountreadOnly via chart extraVolumes/extraVolumeMounts.

mpn-identity-alerts.observation: Set detailedObservability.alerts.enabled=true to create alreadyshipped Keycloak realm/user/admin modificationPrometheusRules. Logging/dashboards alreadyenabled. This is GallatinCoreconfiguration, not DU featuredevelopment.

mpn-identity-routes.observation: Route via kube-prometheus-stack chart alertmanager.config.receivers/route, secretbacked notification credentials and uds-prometheus-config.additionalNetworkAllow matching endpoint. Gallatin must select actualSA/ISSO recipients; defaults cannot invent them.

mpn-identity-override.observation: Core value sourcePath .keycloak.keycloak maps to chart root; bundle override path is packages[core].overrides.keycloak.keycloak.values[].path (e.g.realmInitEnv), not Horizonpackageapplication values.

mpn-identity-denylist.observation: Native Keycloak26.7.4 passwordBlacklist(filename) policy reads newline-delimited corpus from $KC_HOME/data/password-blacklists (or configured SPI path) and hotreloads changed file at defaultcheckIntervalSeconds60. Mount/update approvedcorpus and addpolicy; no customstrengthmeter/passwordvalidator service required. Frequency/content remain Gallatinsecuritypolicy decisions.

mpn-identity-age.observation: Native passwordAge policy is historical-password reuse-age validation, not24-hour minimum time before changing to a differentnewpassword. Do not falsely propose passwordAge(1) for minchangeinterval; no Coredefault/customvalidator implementing8characterdistance/24hminchange supplied.

mpn-core-init-default.observation: Core1.14 local setup initializes from Zarf init v0.86.0 without a registry-mode override. bundles/k3d-standard likewise includes that init package without mTLS/proxy selection. Production Core explicitly assumes a separately provided cluster and init bundle, not a DU-operated cluster.

mpn-registry-mode.observation: Zarf0.86 FillInEmptyValues defaults internal registry mode to nodeport; MTLSStrategy defaults none. KnownPlainHTTP identifies internal registry without mTLS as HTTP. Proxy mode is a distinct configurable transport.

mpn-registry-proxy.observation: Exact Zarf0.86 init reference documents --registry-mode=proxy as built-in cross-node mTLS. This is a Gallatin bootstrap choice, not unknown vendor behavior. Proxy mode is marked alpha.

mpn-registry-tls-floor.observation: The registry chart configData helper inserts server certificate/key/client CA settings with minimumtls tls1.2 when mtls.enabled. Proxy daemonset uses OPENSSL with client certificate and verified CA; clear node-side listener is local-loopback rather than cross-node plaintext.

mpn-registry-prune.observation: Zarf0.86 includes tools registry prune, which deletes images not referenced by any current Zarf package; --confirm explicitly authorizes pruning. It is an executable maintenance action, not a Core automatic upgrade hook.

mpn-core-storage-boundary.observation: Core production prerequisites require an existing Kubernetes cluster and default storage class. Core does not select the MPN control-plane distribution, storage encryption provider or node volume encryption implementation.

mpn-core-keycloak-pvc.observation: Keycloak PVCs set storageClassName only if persistence.storageClassName is selected; templates configure capacity/access but not storage encryption or host datastore encryption. Default Core cannot establish MPN keystore/data volume protection without a host-storage choice.

mpn-core-inactivity-setting.observation: Gallatin can set keycloak realmInitEnv.ACCOUNT_INACTIVITY_DAYS=35 to enable initial realm workflow. Source warns realm import is initial-only; existing realm requires directly enabling/updating disable-inactive-users workflow with after35d. Admin accounts are excepted and never-used accounts require handling.

mpn-core-known-identity-settings.observation: Known Core settings: realmInitEnv.TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS_ENABLED and themeCustomizations.termsAndConditions.text.inline/configmap; realmInitEnv.SSO_SESSION_MAX_PER_USER (default0 unlimited); realmInitEnv.X509_CRL_CHECKING_ENABLED/RELATIVE_PATH/ABORT_IF_NON_UPDATED; detailedObservability.alerts.enabled(defaultfalse), logging.enabled/defaulttrue. These are Gallatin configuration choices.

mpn-core-account-alerts.observation: Core account/admin modification PrometheusRules are gated only on detailedObservability.alerts.enabled. Gallatin can enable them and configure recipients in its own Alertmanager deployment; vendor-provided proof is unnecessary.

mpn-core-falco-notify.observation: Falco sends structured events to Loki by default. falcosidekick.config.alertmanager.hostport/endpoint are documented but commented; Gallatin can enable the route to monitoring Alertmanager and configure receivers itself.

mpn-host-secret-encryption.observation: Kubernetes API Secrets are plaintext in etcd unless the selected API-server --encryption-provider-config uses a nonidentity encryption provider first. This is a host/control-plane configuration, separate from Core workload manifests and encrypted PVC selection.
